topic: Deep-dive research on the Obsidian plugin 'Beancount Ledger' (id beancount-finance, author mkshp, v2.3.1, GitHub github.com/mkshp-dev), for an AI operating the vault at the FILE LAYER. It manages a Beancount ledger with live BQL queries, transaction management, and net-worth/balance tracking; it shells out to python beanquery (bean-query) and beanprice (bean-price). Resolve the EXACT data model: (a) the Beancount v3 ledger directives it reads/writes (open, transaction+postings, balance, price, pad, note, commodity, include; multi-currency and cost-basis {} lots); (b) the plugin's OWN settings/state schema in .obsidian/plugins/beancount-finance/data.json (READ the plugin source main.js from the mkshp-dev GitHub repo); (c) how it invokes bean-query/beanquery for BQL and bean-price for prices, and the BQL query-language surface. Cover the full feature surface (live BQL queries, transaction entry UI, net-worth/balance dashboards); every command + setting key; file-layer AI workflows (add account, append balanced transaction, BQL query recipes matching the dashboards, bulk CSV import, reconciliation); a full error/edge-case catalog (unbalanced entry, unopened account, currency mismatch, malformed date, bean-check errors, cost-basis lots); AI-usage recipes. Cite sources (mkshp-dev repo + main.js, Beancount + beanquery docs). Produce a verified data-model + workflows + troubleshooting knowledge base.
